title: Chief Financial Officer Programme
description: Embark on a 12 month learning journey in Financial Leadership, Corporate Governance, and Digital Leadership.

content.title: who should join
points: Current CFOs: Refine financial leadership and stay ahead of trends.
Senior Finance Leaders (SVP, Directors, Controllers): Scale influence and prepare for the CFO seat.
High-Potential Finance Managers: Gain comprehensive insights into financial leadership.
Strategic Executives: Deepen understanding of CFO responsibilities.
Financial Consultants: Understand CFO challenges to better serve clients.
Industry Experts: Shift from technical finance to executive leadership.

content.title: program snapshot
points: 4 Pillars - Financial Leadership, Corporate Governance, and Digital Leadership
Learn from esteemed IIM Visakhapatnam faculty and top industry professionals.
Financial Strategy, M&A, and Financial Analytics Simulations
Campus Immersions: One Campus Immersion of 3 days
No Cost EMI up to 12 months

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Develop a comprehensive financial plan for a company planning to enter new international markets. Analyze target markets, create detailed financial forecasts, & propose capital allocation strategies. Assess potential risks & provide mitigation strategies. Develop a strategic market entry plan & an implementation roadmap with key milestones. Define performance metrics to measure success. Present the plan to a panel, explaining key components & recommendations.

content.title: Is prior experience in Finance required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In the Chief Financial Officer Programme, you will have access to case studies and Capstone Projects to gain a better understanding of the real-world applications of financial leadership concepts.

content.title: How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 12 months.

content.title: How is the IIM Visakhapatnam's CFO program different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class :

- **Advanced Pedagogical Approach:** IIM Visakhapatnam's advanced pedagogical approach, supported by its rank of 26th by NIRF, ensures a cutting-edge, innovative, and effective learning experience. This method fosters deep understanding and real-world application of Financial Leadership concepts.

- **Bridging Ideas to Industry:** IIM Visakhapatnam bridges academic ideas to real-world industry applications through a structured framework, fostering practical learning and career readiness. This ensures that students are not only theoretically knowledgeable but also equipped to tackle contemporary business challenges effectively.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
